description: Bundled type-spec for orchestration's exception hierarchy, grouped in one file like storage_types since none carry independent logic beyond carrying a stage name.
signature:
class PipelineError(Exception): ...

class PipelineCancelled(PipelineError):
    def __init__(self, stage: str) -> None: ...
    stage: str

class PreflightError(PipelineError):
    def __init__(self, message: str, *, cause: Exception | None = None) -> None: ...
    cause: Exception | None
docstring:
PipelineError: Base class for this module. Raised directly for invalid resume requests and other orchestration-level misuse (see resume_run's edge cases) -- not raised by a stage entry point itself.

PipelineCancelled: Raised at exactly one of the seven enumerated cancellation check-points (CP1-CP7, see run_pipeline and RateLimiter). Carries which stage it was raised in, since run_pipeline's finally block needs this to call finish_run_stage(stage, 'cancelled') for the right stage. Never raised outside a check-point -- it is not a general-purpose 'something was interrupted' exception.

PreflightError: Raised when config.load_parameters raises ParameterError, or when the ADR-013 parameters.toml/FORMULATION.md consistency check fails. Wraps the original exception as cause so the underlying validation message is never lost, even though PreflightError's own message is what gets truncated into runs.error_message. Raised after storage.create_run has already inserted the run row (so a preflight failure is still visible in the run list) but before any run_stages row exists.
preconditions: PipelineCancelled.stage is one of PipelineStage's three values
PreflightError.cause, when set, is the original exception (typically config.ParameterError) that triggered it
postconditions: PreflightError.cause, when not None, is accessible for logging the full underlying validation message even though it is not embedded in runs.error_message

edge_cases.input: PipelineCancelled raised with stage='pipeline' (RUN_LEVEL_STAGE, not a real PipelineStage)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: not a valid construction per this module's own contract -- PipelineCancelled is only ever raised from within a stage's execution or from CP1/CP5, both of which know a real PipelineStage value; constructing it with RUN_LEVEL_STAGE would be a caller bug

edge_cases.input: PreflightError constructed with cause=None (a validation failure with no underlying exception, e.g. a hand-written assertion)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: valid; cause is optional for exactly this reason

unit_tests.name: test_pipelinecancelled_carries_stage
unit_tests.description: PipelineCancelled('enrichment').stage == 'enrichment' and the stage name appears in str().
unit_tests.expected: stage attribute and string representation both contain 'enrichment'

unit_tests.name: test_preflighterror_wraps_cause
unit_tests.description: PreflightError('bad weights', cause=ParameterError('...')).cause is the original ParameterError instance.
unit_tests.expected: cause is not None and isinstance(cause, ParameterError)

unit_tests.name: test_preflighterror_is_pipelineerror
unit_tests.description: PreflightError and PipelineCancelled are both instances of PipelineError.
